CloudStream F-Droid repo

F-Droid repository hosting the CloudStream app: stable and pre-release builds.

Currently it serves 4 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Foxu89/fdroid-cloudstream/main/fdroid/repo
